verdict.rationale: Signifyd offers a well-documented public REST API with endpoints for Checkout, Sale, Decisions, Chargebacks, and webhooks, authenticated and callable programmatically — clearly usable by any automated/AI-native client. Missing for 10: no explicit agent/LLM-oriented tooling (e.g., official SDK for agentic orchestration) or independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs, and llms.txt is absent (404).
